name: Cadet Major insignia on the 2 in OCP square
size_basis: Square is 2 in x 2 in (CAPR 39-1 7.1.1.2.1, regulation). Insignia is the Fig A5-6 regular-size geometry scaled by 0.7778 so the largest cadet officer stack leaves 1/8 in of blue; the regulation gives no insignia size for the square.
layout: centered vertically; field-grade diamonds with the long points horizontal; company-grade circles added vertically (7.1.1.2.2)

mounts.rule: center of chest (7.1.1.2.1); garment landmark rank_square
2 in squared Velcro cloth rank, flush and centered above the nametape (7.1.1.11.2); same orientation as the OCP (long points horizontal, circles stacked vertically, 7.1.1.2.2)
